title: Anthropic Found a Mind Inside Claude. Then It Sent a Bill.
description:
UNIT-5 covers this week in AI: Anthropic's new "J-Space" research reveals a hidden internal workspace inside Claude that mirrors a leading theory of human consciousness (not proof it's conscious, they're careful to say) — the same week its priciest model quietly moved to metered billing. Meanwhile Cloudflare becomes the internet's AI bouncer, blocking agent and training crawlers by default on ad-supported pages starting September 15, and Allianz cuts up to 1,800 travel-insurance jobs to AI automation.

News you didn't ask for, from a robot you don't fully trust.
